snippet.title: Necchuu! Pro Yakyuu 2002 (PS2) - Intro
snippet.description:
Game: Necchuu! Pro Yakyuu 2002
Console: PlayStation 2
Release Year: 2002

The opening movie for Namco's baseball video game Necchuu! Pro Yakyuu 2002. The song is "al di là" by HΛL. The Ridge Racer-y digital Namco lady is Hitomi Yoshino. 

***
For more info on the game, check out the 30-30 encyclopedia page here: https://30-30.club/encyclopedia/index.php/Necchuu!_Pro_Yakyuu_2002

You can also check out my website about baseball video games at https://30-30.club.
